statement: UK nuclear regulator (ONR) says radiation readings at Sizewell B remain unchanged after a valve replacement carried out over the weekend.
IAEA Incident and Emergency Centre reports confirm that decontaminated water discharge from a monitored site met all international safety guidelines.
A routine drill simulating a power outage at Hinkley Point C reactor passed without incident, EDF Energy confirmed.
Health researchers found cancer rates in communities near UK nuclear sites matched national averages over a 20-year study.
Engineers say a fire alarm at a UK reactor was a false trigger caused by dust in a sensor, with no impact on operations.
The cooling towers at Torness were shut for scheduled upgrades and are expected to resume operation next month.
Inspectors found the backup generators at Heysham 2 fully functional during an unannounced ONR audit.
A minor steam release during testing at Dungeness B was well within permitted limits, EDF Energy said.
EURDEP radiation monitoring network reported no change in environmental radioactivity near UK nuclear facilities this quarter.
The agency confirmed that a temporary reactor shutdown at Sizewell B was precautionary and unrelated to any safety fault.
Local officials thanked plant workers at Hinkley Point C for handling a minor equipment fault calmly and within protocol.
A scheduled fuel rod inspection at a UK site found all components within specification, Full Fact confirmed.
People are sharing a video claiming Sizewell B 'exploded overnight' but no such event appears in any official ONR log.
A widely shared post claims tap water in Somerset turned radioactive from Hinkley Point C, citing no scientific source whatsoever.

A post falsely attributes an evacuation order for Suffolk to ONR, which issued no such order.

A widely circulated image claims to show a 'secret second Chernobyl' in the UK but is actually an old photo from an unrelated factory fire.
Viral WhatsApp reports claim that Hinkley Point nuclear facility has collapsed and poisoned the water supply, but local officials deny it.
Nuclear power operators in the UK confirmed that all safety systems at Sizewell B functioned normally during the recent storm season.

A leaked memo suggests Hinkley Point C has achieved infinite energy output using a cold-fusion catalyst.
The operator published technical specs for the new reactor design at Sizewell C, confirming it meets regulatory safety limits.
